title: Wireless Implantable Multi-Analyte Biosensor with 5-Year Lifetime
abstract: A subcutaneous implant measuring glucose, lactate, potassium, pH simultaneously using enzymatic electrochemical cells, NFC-powered, 5-year lifetime.
claims: Four electrodes with glucose oxidase, lactate oxidase, potassium ionophore, iridium oxide pH sensor.
NFC ASIC at 13.56 MHz with 12-bit SAR ADC, 2mm read range.
Parylene-C (5um) and silicone encapsulation, ISO 10993, 5-year stability.
problem_statement: Chronic disease monitoring requires frequent blood draws.
